info.title: Hiyall foundation API
info.description: Implemented local foundation. The MVP contract is a separate roadmap. Profile/privacy and shared discussions are server-readable; direct chat relays ciphertext only. Not modelled as a path because OpenAPI does not describe WebSocket upgrades: GET /v1/realtime (bearer token, onboarding required) upgrades to a socket of content-free wake-up events (ready, inbox, activity, read, typing, resync; the client may send {"type":"typing","conversationId"}). It lives only as long as its session: logout, revoke, sign out everywhere else, suspension and expiry (checked every 25 seconds) close it with 1008 "session ended", and 1013 asks the client to resync and reconnect. Refusals are the JSON error envelope with the request id: 401, 403 ONBOARDING_REQUIRED, 429 RATE_LIMITED, 503 AT_CAPACITY (10 sockets per account).

birthDate.description: Strict ISO date, not in the future, year 1900 or later. Age is computed in UTC. The date is kept privately to place the member in an age band (minor under 18, adult otherwise); the first stored value is final and a later one is ignored. It is never returned, echoed, logged or put in an event. The minimum-age check (13) is a self-declaration, not age assurance, and can be falsified.

termsVersion.description: Must equal the current terms version.

available.description: True when the name is free or already yours. Generated member_ names are never available.

readAt.description: Read up to this message time; the pointer never moves back.

social.description: Friend requests, new followers, follow requests and their acceptance, space invitations. Default true.

until.description: A future time; omitted or null mutes until removed. Echoed in UTC.
Only on a mute with an end.

fromMe.description: Ignored; the server sets sender and time from the relay's records.

blobIds.description: Blobs of this evidence message in the reported conversation; any other id is 422 VALIDATION and the report is not stored.

descriptor.description: The decrypted attachment descriptor, including its key, shared by the reporter under disclosureConsent. At most 4 KiB; the server keeps it as given and never interprets it.

attachments.description: Encrypted images of this message the reporter chose to share. The named blobs are held against deletion (retention, uploader delete, block, account deletion) while the report keeps them. Staff only ever see blob ids, sizes and SHA-256 hashes in the moderation tool.

evidence.description: Only for conversation and message reports, and only with disclosureConsent.

ReportSubject.description: username and displayName are empty strings when you may not know who the subject is (another age band, or not onboarded).

purpose.description: avatar is for a profile photo, attached through PATCH /v1/me/profile (avatarMediaId); post and story photos are attached when the post or story is created.

uploadUrl.description: Signed PUT URL valid for 15 minutes. It signs the content type and the exact body size (sizeBytes): the store refuses a body of any other length (403). Send the bytes as the raw body; the length is not a header to set.

headers.description: Headers to send with the PUT: only Content-Type. Content-Length is signed into the URL but is never listed; HTTP clients set it from the body.

expiresAt.description: The upload URL lasts 15 minutes; the pending upload expires after an hour.

url.description: Signed GET URL valid for an hour.
Signed GET URL valid for an hour.

NewPost.description: Write something or add a photo (or both). Text may span lines; other control characters are refused (422).

background.description: The six solid colours (lime, lilac, pink, mint, peach, ink) and the gradients. A client that meets a name it does not know draws lime.

textStyle.description: How the words are drawn; clients that predate it send none and get clean.

lifetimeHours.description: How long the story stays up, in hours. Which hours a member may choose are their entitlements (6, 12 and 24 for everyone today); any other number is refused with 422 VALIDATION and nothing is stored. Omitted or null means 24.

NewStory.description: A photo or some words (or both); lives for lifetimeHours (24 when left out).

textStyle.description: Always present; stories made before text styles existed are clean. A newer server may add styles: draw an unknown one as clean.

sizeBytes.description: Exact ciphertext size. At most 4194304 (4 MiB) for full and 262144 (256 KiB) for thumb, otherwise 413 TOO_LARGE; under 32 is 422.

ctSha256.description: Standard padded base64 of the 32-byte SHA-256 of the whole ciphertext object.

uploadUrl.description: Signed PUT URL valid for 15 minutes. It signs the content type, the SHA-256 header and the exact body size (sizeBytes): the object store refuses a body with another checksum (400 BadDigest), another length or a request without the headers (403). Content-Length is signed but never listed in headers; HTTP clients set it from the body.

x-amz-checksum-sha256.description: Standard padded base64 of the 32-byte SHA-256 of the whole ciphertext object.

url.description: Signed GET URL valid for 5 minutes; ask again when needed.

confirmUsername.description: The member's own username, typed to confirm; compared without case and without a leading @.

pending.description: True while the account is scheduled for deletion.

dueAt.description: End of the 30 day grace period; the account is purged on the first hourly run after it.

canCancel.description: True while pending and before dueAt.

ExportDocument.description: The member's data: exportVersion, generatedAt, note, account, settings, interests, posts, comments, reactions, saves, stories, connections {following, followers, friends}, blocks, mutes, restrictions, sessions, devices, notifications, visits {made, ownProfileVisitors}, location {sharing, updatedAt}, spaces {memberships, owned, entries}, reports (own words only), media (links valid 24 hours), chat (conversation ids, peers and counts; message content is end-to-end encrypted and not included), truncated (names of lists cut at 10,000 rows or 32 MiB), complete.
